marta_support: Customer reports 15–30s tail latency and occasional 429s when hitting their Dedicated pool (eu-west-2-dedicated-3) under a ramp from 5->40 concurrent sessions. They ran a perf test at 09:12 UTC. They see request queueing then 429s.

sasha: Can you paste the request IDs and which model variant they were using? Any recent config changes (min/max replicas, autoscaler policy)?

marta_support: Sent logs, sample req id 9f4a3b. Model: gpt-small-q4f16. Config snippet from customer: ```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 20
scale_up_step: 2
scale_up_cooldown: 60s
prewarm: disabled
```

omar_oncall: I repro locally with a synthetic burst (k=45 over 30s) against that pool. Autoscaler starts creating pods but we see node spinup + model load delaying ready->serving by ~18-22s. While pods are initializing the request queue hits limit and returns 429s. Deploy bot showed these events: "deploy-bot: scale_event:start 1945003290" and then "deploy-bot: pod_ready 1945003450" — long gap.

lucy_eng: Looks like two factors: (1) model cold init ~12s (quantized weights load + warmup), (2) k8s node scheduling/image pull ~6–8s. Combined crosses our latency SLO and the autoscaler only adds 2 replicas per step so it can't catch the surge fast.

marta_support: Customer is asking for a root cause and immediate mitigation. They're on a paid Dedicated contract and hit production traffic.

omar_oncall: Interim mitigations:
- bump min_replicas to 4 for this pool (quick config change)
- enable burst_reserve=true (allows temporary overprovision from spare capacity)
- suggest customer switch to gpt-small-q4f16-fast (a warmed/quantized variant) if available

sasha: I can push min_replicas change if we approve. Any safety/charge impacts? 

lucy_eng: Bumping min_replicas increases cost but will avoid 429s. burst_reserve requires infra approval (may affect other tenants). I'll open an eng-runtime task to evaluate predictive-scaling for this pool and reduce model init by streaming weights (longer term).

deploy-bot: incident created https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1123 (sev3). Assigned: eng-runtime.

omar_oncall: Repro steps I used:
1) run `wrk -c 45 -t 8 -d 60s https://api.redwood.example/dedicated/pool/eu-west-2-dedicated-3/generate`
2) observe queue depth and 429 spikes in the first 30s
3) check pod lifecycle: `kubectl get pods -w -n dedicated-eu-west-2`

lucy_eng: Quick patch we can apply today: change scale_up_step from 2 -> 6 and add a short warmup hook to prefetch KV cache on start. Patch queued in PR #4487.

marta_support: Customer asked for ETA to mitigation — told them we'll apply min_replicas bump within 15m and follow up once burst_reserve decision is made.

sasha: I changed min_replicas -> 4 for pool eu-west-2-dedicated-3 (rolling config) at 1945003500. Monitoring now shows baseline latency drop and no new 429s in last 6m. I'll monitor for cost spikes.

omar_oncall: Keeping this thread for notes. Next steps: eng-runtime to land predictive scaling proto, eng-ml to investigate fast-weight streaming, and support to notify customer when permanent fix is live. :thumbsup:
